title: Independent verification: P112 root-star cost 64 via maximal-clique census
body:
This independently verifies David Arias' #1236 result: masked P112 decoders whose paid supports are exactly the root stars C(alpha) or N(alpha) have minimum copy cost **64**, at any finite term count. The coordinate decoder already attains it. **No new theorem priority, kappa, physical supplier, or selected-frontier change is claimed.**

The distinct evidence is a pivoted maximal-clique census: all **27,968 maximal cliques** and their subsets recover all **482,577 cliques**, with maximum size eight. This checks the nine-cost-seven obstruction by a different route from #1236's lattice/quadratic-form checker. A separate direct reconstruction computes all **57,600 binary atom ranks** and **1,260 frames**, then matches all five geometric sections of #1236's pinned certificate, including the full root, support, frame and atom-stream hashes. Neither new implementation imports predecessor executable code.

The package includes a written proof, every atom rank, exact source pins, semantic failure controls, and a path-scoped Python 3.12 workflow. Reproduce from the repository root:

```sh
python3 -I -O -B research/root-star-integer-cover-seed46/test_package.py
```

Expected: six test groups pass (`Ran 6 tests`, `OK`). The final package passed on CPython **3.14.6 and 3.12.13**, including both complete implementations, five certificate mutations rejected by both, an injected nine-clique, altered support/decoder controls, source corruption, optimized standalone relocation, exact regeneration and overwrite protection. The pinned #1226 replay, selected-result integrity check and all five selected-result regressions also passed. Hosted CI and the full selected-supplier cold replay are not claimed.

Base: `49b3157d1d89adcef16df8be98445451672be5ba`. Audited #1236: `ee8437bd9879272094e20c024cd34a53c4e84cd8`; predecessor #1226: `8b10989e4e45f0f9ce41004d7898a21a32f87e11`. The refreshed main had no changes to the selected record, contribution instructions or this package's paths. Seed **46** assigned structural decoder research; the overlap refresh found the concurrent #1236 after the same endpoint argument was developed, so this submission is explicitly independent verification.

The theorem allows arbitrary real/complex coefficients and free cost-zero corrections, but excludes arbitrary proper sub-supports, further trims, unions, other punctures and changed copying/stage accounting. Compiler/all-size, mutable-source, hosting, precision/tape, analytic and bit-interface obligations remain inherited. The check does not certify #1236's execution-control claims or rerun its separate lattice receipt.

Credit David Arias / @DavidAriasC (#1236), Navinor (#1226), DreamingOfClouds (#717/#595), Joel Pulikkan / GamingPuzzled and the retained coordinate-decoder lineage. Prepared by **Hanson Sun (@bbMisk)** with substantial **OpenAI Codex assistance** in research, proof, both implementations, tests and writing. No independent human review claimed; Apache-2.0.
